name: life
description: Daily goals tracker — report progress toward customizable daily goals via web UI or API.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.live: npm run build && concurrently -k -n web,server -c green,blue "npm --prefix web run build -- --watch" "LIVE_RELOAD=1 npm --prefix server run live"
